messages.text: Hi, I’m wondering what the status is on my return label for the BSB 6th miner? I already did the incident form.
Sorry about the faulty unit. I can chase that up. What's your order number, or the email on the order? One of those is enough for me to pull it up.
(email hidden)
Used the store-orders skill
Used the heliumdeploy-ops-knowledge skill
Ran order_status.py (store-orders skill)
Ran warehouse.py (store-orders skill)
Handed to the team · RMA return label not yet raised, I cannot issue labels.

Found it, the NerdQaxe++ Rev 6.1 (6TH/s) on order Shop····, delivered July 9. Your form is in, but no return label has been raised on it yet, so I've pushed it to the team now. Someone will jump into this chat with the label, and if you step away you'll get it by email instead. One quick thing they'll ask: was the unit ever overclocked or modified?
No

Good, that keeps it fully covered under warranty. I've noted it on the case so they don't have to ask again.

Nothing else needed from you right now, just hang tight here for the label. Anything else I can sort while you're here?
No and thank you for your help
Used the chat-interview skill
Ran dossier.py (chat-interview skill)
Before you go, one thing: what made you send the NerdQaxe back rather than troubleshoot it?
When I moved it to get better airflow, it started to throw sparks

Sparks is a safety issue, so please leave it unplugged and don't power it up again, even to test it.

I've added that to your case so the team treats it as urgent and gets the label out. If you can, take a photo of the board and the PSU connector while it's unplugged. They'll ask for it.
Handed to the team · Safety incident reported mid-chat, needs urgent handling alongside the pending R
The team has it flagged as urgent now. Stay in the chat and one of them will jump in here with the label, and if you step away it comes to your email.
Ok
Thanks for flagging the sparks, that was worth knowing. Sit tight, they'll be with you shortly.
The fuse on the unit did not blow

Noted, I've put that on the case. An intact fuse usually points at something arcing on the board or at the connector rather than a dead short, so JD will want to see it either way.

Keep it unplugged and don't swap the fuse. If you want the fastest technical read on it, JD is on our Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, post there and mention @nullhashrate. Otherwise he'll answer you here or by email.
Jd has already seen the photo I sent in discord

Good, that saves a step. I've noted that JD has already seen the photo on Discord, so the team can go straight to the label.

Nothing more needed from you. They'll come back in this chat or by email.
Thank you

Any time. A copy of this whole conversation comes to your email once we're done here, so you'll have the details in writing.

Take care, and keep that unit unplugged.
I already have it boxed up and ready to go

Perfect, that puts you ahead of it. Once the label lands in your inbox, print it, stick it on that box and drop it off.

Processing takes up to 10 days from when it reaches the warehouse. I've noted on the case that it's already packed.
